# ARTEX demonstration report — Acme Corp

## Overview
Scope: acme.com and its web, admin, API, shop, and VPN subdomains.

## Example findings
- Default administrative credentials
- SQL injection
- Missing object-level authorization
- Reflected XSS, exposed Git metadata, and missing login rate limits

## Recommendations
Require strong credentials and MFA, parameterize database queries, encode output, enforce object-level authorization, and protect signing keys.

This report contains synthetic demonstration data only.
